name: a002-physical32-clean-identity-build
purpose: Force fresh package rebuild with upstream dependencies and real server owning-KV Buffer/admission identity; lockedcheck131host and capture immutable plainserver
command:
set -e
cargo check --locked --bin server > experiments/physical-pool32-export/identity-check.log 2>&1
cargo test --locked --lib --config profile.test.package.furiosa-opt-gemma4.debug=0 > experiments/physical-pool32-export/identity-host-tests.log 2>&1
cargo furiosa-opt build --release --bin server > experiments/physical-pool32-export/identity-build.log 2>&1
